comparison.objective: Fold a limp humanoid robot forward past its balance point so its back hatch faces upward.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated-body handling, balance transition, and pose control in constrained terrain.
comparison.success_condition: Robot finishes with its back hatch facing up. Pose, collision, and damage tolerances are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Articulated-body reorientation is a different tested ability from localized tool-mediated fracture and loose-fragment containment.
